title: Neon Rain
description: Moody night aura edit: slow-motion hero moments in a rain-wet city, teal-and-black grade, glow, white flashes on the drops and slammed blackletter titles.

example.credit: Example made with open-katana: a fictional person (generated with Z-Image Turbo) on an original ACE-Step 1.5 XL track.

brief.label: Your title word
brief.help: Set in blackletter, slammed on the drop.

brief.label: Your city at night
brief.prompt: Place: {value} at night, rain-wet, teal neon reflections.
suggestions: a bus stop in the rain

recipe.look: teal-night grade, crushed blacks, light film grain, soft glow on highlights, subtle vignette
recipe.energy: Slow first act (1–2 cuts per second), then cuts on every beat after the drop with zoom punches and short shake bursts on hits; 3–5 white flashes per 10 s, always on hits.

structure.guidance: Slow push-in on the hero in shadow; eyes lift to the lens. No text yet.
Details: hands, jacket, silhouette against city lights, a walk toward camera in slow motion.
White flash on the drop, slam the title word in blackletter with glow.
Beat-cut montage of stares, turns and wind in hair; punch-ins on every second beat; one freeze frame.
Final slow stare into the lens, flash out to black on the last hit.

recipe.titles: One or two words max per card, uppercase, centred; blackletter for the title word, Anton for captions.
recipe.music: Dark phonk or slowed trap with a clear drop; use the reference's track when one is supplied.
recipe.generation: Keyframes: compose the hero into each night location plate (rain-wet street, underpass, rooftop). Clips: 2–3 s Wan I2V slow-motion moments; motion transfer with pose control only for performances the reference needs.

prompt: Make @image1 the hero of a dark aura edit. Keep their face, hair and clothing exactly; nights are wet, neon reflections are teal, and every move is slow and deliberate.
author: open-katana
